novi-sad-station-canopy-collapse.conditions_add: The China Eximbank preferential buyer credit loan agreement for the Novi Sad-Subotica-Kelebija railway section, a US$988,388,500 loan to Serbia's Ministry of Finance against the commercial contract of 7 July 2018 with the China Railway International and China Communications Construction Company joint venture, required that goods, technologies and services bought with the money "shall be purchased from China preferentially according to the Commercial Contract" (Article 2.5). Article 2.4 limited the money to "the sole purpose of the payment of approximately eighty five percent (85%) of the Commercial Contract amount" and barred its use for brokerage fees, agency fees or commissions. Before each drawdown Serbia had to show it had paid the contractor from its own funds, with the ratio of self-raised funds to loan "not be lower than 15:85" (Preferential Buyer Credit Loan Agreement).

plan-colombia-aerial-spraying.conditions_add: US appropriations law limited how the spraying money could be spent. A Congressional Research Service brief records that the FY2002 foreign operations act, P.L. 107-115, "included conditions on the use of funds for purchase of chemicals for the aerial spraying program in Colombia". The State Department's Memorandum of Justification for the spraying sets out what those conditions required: no more than 20 percent of the funds could buy spray chemicals unless the Secretary of State certified, after consulting the Environmental Protection Agency, that the herbicide mixture "is being used in accordance with EPA label requirements for comparable use in the United States", that as used it "does not pose unreasonable risks of adverse effects to humans or the environment", and that complaints of harm to health or to legal crops are evaluated and "fair compensation is being paid for meritorious claims". The money could also not be used unless alternative development programmes were being carried out in consultation with local communities.

why.safeguard: does not pose unreasonable risks of adverse effects to humans or the environment
why.admin: complaints of harm to health or to legal crops are evaluated
